title: tsurara configuration
description: An tsurara configuration file. Entries written at the top level are the defaults for every target.

$schema.description: JSON Schema of this file, for editors.

extends.description: Base configuration files, resolved against this file. Objects are deep-merged and arrays are replaced.

targets.description: Generation targets. Without `targets`, the top level is the only target.

name.description: Name of the target, used by `tsurara generate --target`. Required when there are several targets.

input.description: The definition: a path relative to this file, or a URL.

output.description: Output directory, relative to this file.

language.description:
The language to generate (default `typescript`), whose options go in the section named after
it; or a backend program as `{ command, options }` (design.md 18.11).

splitVisibility.description: Emit `XWritable` types for schemas with readOnly/writeOnly (default true).

wildcardAsJson.description:
Treat wildcard media types (`*/*`, `application/*`) as JSON, for APIs that only return JSON
(default false: parse by the actual Content-Type).

operations.description:
Generate the operations (default true). With `false` the output holds the types of the
schemas, webhooks and channels only, and needs only the types layer of the runtime: no HTTP
client.

runtime.description:
Where generated code finds its runtime (default `package`): `vendor` writes a copy of the
runtime's sources into the output and imports it instead of the package.

plugins.description:
Plugin modules (`@tsurara/plugin`): each runs in one process per run and takes part in the
stages it declares. A path to the module, or `{ module, runtime }` with the command that runs
it (default `[node]`). Paths are relative to the file they are written in.

typescript.description: Options of the TypeScript backend (`language: typescript`).

python.description: Options of the Python backend (`language: python`).

rust.description: Options of the Rust backend (`language: rust`, experimental).

go.description: Options of the Go backend (`language: go`, experimental).

name.description: Name of the target, used by `tsurara generate --target`. Required when there are several targets.

input.description: The definition: a path relative to this file, or a URL.

output.description: Output directory, relative to this file.

typescript.description: Options of the TypeScript backend (`language: typescript`).

python.description: Options of the Python backend (`language: python`).

rust.description: Options of the Rust backend (`language: rust`, experimental).

go.description: Options of the Go backend (`language: go`, experimental).

url.description: A path relative to this file, or a URL.

headers.description: HTTP headers, only sent to the origin of `url`. `${VAR}` expands environment variables.

ExternalLanguageConfig.description: A backend written as an external program. The command runs in the directory of this file.

excludeTags.description: Operations with one of these tags are left out.

excludeOperationIds.description: Operations with one of these `operationId`s are left out.

overrides.description:
Preferred names per JSON Pointer (such as `#/components/schemas/Error`), for every language;
each language's naming rules still apply.

RuntimeConfig.description: Where generated code finds its runtime.

oneOf.description: The package of the language's registry.
A copy of the runtime in the output.

HooksConfig.description: External command hooks (design.md chapter 11). Commands run in the directory of the file they are written in.

transformDocument.description: Receives the root definition as JSON on stdin and returns the transformed definition on stdout.

transformModel.description:
Receives the model as JSON on stdin and returns the transformed model on stdout
(design.md 18.4.6). The JSON form is versioned by `semVersion`.

extend.description:
Receives the model, the manifest of what the backend generated and the generated-file marker
as JSON on stdin, and returns files to add (`[{ path, contents }]`) on stdout. Each added file
must start with the marker.

transformFiles.description: Receives the output files as JSON on stdin and returns the transformed list on stdout.

afterWrite.description: Runs after writing. `{output}` is replaced with the output directory.

Commands.description: One command or a list of commands, each written as `[program, ...args]`.

runtime.description: The command that runs the module, before the runner's arguments (default `[node]`).

layout.description: How generated code is split into files (default `split`).

importExtension.description: Extension of relative imports in generated code (default `js`).

bodilessResponses.description:
What happens to the body of an error response the definition gives no content (default
`discard`; `read` reads a body that arrives with a Content-Type, as `unknown`).

validators.description: Emit schemas for response validation under `zod/` (default: none). Only `zod` (Zod 4).

validatorConstraints.description:
Also check the definition's constraints (`minLength`, `maximum`, `pattern`, `minItems`, ...)
and more formats (`uri`, `date`, ...) in the validation schemas (default false).

query.description:
Emit query and mutation options with typed query keys under `query/` (default: none). Only
`tanstack` (TanStack Query 5).

infiniteQueries.description:
Pagination per operation id for infinite query options (with `query: tanstack`); wins over
`x-tsurara-pagination` in the definition.

mocks.description:
Emit mock factories and request handlers under `mocks/` (default: none): `msw` for MSW
handlers, `fetch` for routes of `mockFetch` (`@tsurara/client/testing`).

aggregateMaps.description: Emit `paths.ts` and `operations.ts` for generic clients (default false).

clientModule.description: Module name of the runtime library (default `@tsurara/client`).

overrides.description: Replaces the emitted type per JSON Pointer (such as `#/components/schemas/Uuid`).

InfiniteQueryConfig.description: How a read is paginated, for its infinite query options.

param.description: The parameter that carries the page: its `in`, a dot and its name (`query.cursor`).

initial.description: The value of the first page (default: the parameter is left out of the first request).

next.description:
JSON Pointer to the next page's value in a success body (`/nextCursor`); absent or `null` there
ends the query. Without it, the app gives `getNextPageParam`.

previous.description: JSON Pointer to the previous page's value.

TypeConfig.description: A type of the target language, either as code or with the import it needs.

from.description:
Module specifier (TypeScript: paths starting with `.` are relative to this file; Go: the
import path).

overrides.description: TypeScript identifiers per JSON Pointer, used as they are.

functionCase.description: How function names are made from operation ids (default `preserve`).

typePrefix.description: Put before the names of schema types (`Api` gives `ApiPet`).

enumKeyCase.description: How the keys of `enumStyle: const` objects are written (default `preserve`).

strictEnums.description:
Enums and discriminators reject values the definition does not list, instead of keeping them
where values are received (default false).

mocks.description: Emit mock values and routes for `MockRouter` in the subpackage `mocks` (default false).

runtimeCrate.description: The path generated code uses for the runtime crate (default `tsurara_client`).

mocks.description:
Emit mock values and routes for `MockTransport` in the module `mocks`, compiled for tests and
with the crate feature `mocks` (default false).

typeMappings.description: Replaces the emitted type per `format`: a type path (`chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>`).

overrides.description: Replaces the emitted type per JSON Pointer (such as `#/components/schemas/Uuid`).

package.description:
The package name of the generated files (default: the output directory's name, as a Go
identifier).

runtimeModule.description: The import path of the runtime module (default `github.com/tsurara-openapi/tsurara/runtimes/go`).

typeMappings.description:
Replaces the emitted type per `format`: a type, with the import path of its package
(`{ type: time.Time, import: { from: time } }`).

overrides.description: Replaces the emitted type per JSON Pointer (such as `#/components/schemas/Uuid`).

mocks.description:
Emit mock values and routes for `tsuraratest` in files built with the tag `tsurara_mocks`
(default false).
